description_en:
Resets the progress of a scheduled prefetch task and restarts the prefetch from the beginning.
Before calling this operation, you must first create a scheduled prefetch task by calling CreateScheduledPreloadJob to obtain a valid task ID, and then pass the ID to this operation for resetting
description_zh:
重置定时预热任务的进度，从头开始预热。
调用前提：必须先通过 CreateScheduledPreloadJob 创建定时预热任务以获得有效的任务 Id，再传入本接口进行重置
name: ResetScheduledPreloadJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scheduled prefetch task.
><notice>The ID of the scheduled prefetch task. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the response of CreateScheduledPreloadJob after creating a task, or query the ID of an existing task by calling GetScheduledPreloadJob or ListScheduledPreloadJobs.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
定时预热任务ID。
><notice>定时预热任务 ID。此参数为必填项，可通过 CreateScheduledPreloadJob 创建任务后从返回值获取，或通过 GetScheduledPreloadJob / ListScheduledPreloadJobs 查询已有任务的 ID。></notice>
parameters.name: id
